lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Right. If it is paying somebody, there is an instrument that says so.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Steward's governing charter opens. It is not a statute. It has parties, a term, and a schedule of consideration, which is what a contract has.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: There is a beneficiary clause and the record cannot resolve who it names. It has never been able to. It has simply never been asked.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Somewhere below this floor a fan changes pitch. Your session ends without a prompt.
